units.source_text: 源氏公子回进寺内，诵了一会经，时候已近正午，担心今天疟疾是否发作。

en.t: Prince Genji went back into the temple and chanted sutras for a while, but as noon drew near, he worried whether his malaria would return that day.

units.source_text: 随从人说：“请公子到外边去散散心，不要惦记那病吧。”

en.t: One of his attendants said, “Please go outside and clear your mind, my lord, and try not to dwell on the illness.”

units.source_text: 他就出门，攀登后山，向京城方面眺望。

en.t: So he went out, climbed the hill behind the temple, and gazed toward the capital.

units.source_text: 但见云霞弥漫，一望无际；万木葱茏，如烟如雾。

en.t: Clouds and rosy haze spread endlessly before him, while countless trees stood lush and green, like smoke or mist.
He said, “It truly looks like a painting.

units.source_text: 住在这里的人，定然心旷神怡，无忧无虑的了。”

en.t: The people who live here must surely feel free and refreshed, without a care in the world.”

units.source_text: 随从中有人言道：“这风景还不算顶好呢。

en.t: Someone among the attendants said, “This scenery is still not the very finest.

units.source_text: 公子倘到远方去，看看那些高山大海，一定更加开心，那才真像美丽的图画。

en.t: If you were to travel far away, my lord, and see those high mountains and great seas, you would surely be even more delighted; those are what truly look like beautiful paintings.

units.source_text: 就东部而言，譬如富士山，某某岳……”

en.t: In the eastern provinces, for example, there is Mount Fuji, such-and-such a peak, and so on...”

units.source_text: 也有人将西部的某浦、某矶的风景描摹给公子听。

en.t: Others described for the prince the scenery of certain bays and rocky shores in the west.

units.source_text: 他们谈东说西，好让公子忘了疟疾。

en.t: They talked of places east and west, hoping to make the prince forget his malaria.
